name: sol-survivor
description: Sol Survivor: a browser game for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 (Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer). Not an official NASA product.
aiDisclosure: Code written with AI assistance (Claude Code, Anthropic); commits list it as co-author. Game idea, rules, scenarios, balance targets, playtesting and direction by the team. No AI-generated art: 3D models are Kenney Space Kit (CC0); sounds are generated in code in the browser. No NASA logo or mission insignia is used.
